result: PASS: no actionable firmware defects found in the approved fixes.

documentation_findings.finding: The map still states whole-part and FX M behavior without the drum MIX exception. It also omits the new performance abort controls.
documentation_findings.disposition: Non-blocking and deferred. Stage4 receives this documentation discrepancy. Stage3 does not edit documentation or firmware.
stale_statements: For strips 1–5, **M** toggles the part's mute
On strips 6–8, **M** toggles reverb, delay or master output.
Performance tests own the controls and drain SMC input without editing.

review.result: The visible drum kit and selected bank determine M, SELECT, fader, knob, and M feedback destinations. Track indices stay within 0 to 10. Both kits use keyboard mute_track behavior.
Help, confirmation, menu, and clip priorities remain in place. The new drum branch does not process R or S buttons.

STOP, PLAY, and back call the existing panel abort path. Phase 3 blocks repeated aborts. The poll retains its initial guard across direct, host-note, and both MMC queues. Current perf_testing checks also block input after a queued test start.
The main-loop input handler drains SMC queues before the deferred performance tick. Restoration requires the transport stop to complete.
The full candidate test diff preserves prior assertions. The new regressions use production UI, engine, queue, and SMC code. The registered generated-header runners use class G.

experiments.name: exhaustive helper and LED probe
experiments.scope: Both kits, all 11 selections, all 22 drum mute bits, all eight strips, and menu/confirmation/clip exclusions.
experiments.limit: This probe extracts production functions. It substitutes other UI and engine functions. It does not establish device behavior.

read_failures.cause: A broad source query referenced a missing keys.c path and a later shell glob had no MIDI source matches.
read_failures.disposition: The review used exact ui.c, smc_mixer.c, main_fm1.c, and smc_protocol.h paths. These query errors did not fail a test.
